result.summary: Nadella made few dated AI forecasts in 2026. His main themes were reliable AI systems, safety and human control, and running many models, mostly without dates. Three dated items were found: two five-year remarks on 20VC in October (AI-native companies becoming ordinary, and company evals becoming common, the latter with the span only in the question) and a 'next year' remark on tool use at Morgan Stanley's conference in March. reply_text:
I found three statements from 2026 that pass the test, and one of them only partly. All three are about how widely AI will be used, not about when AGI arrives. I didn't find any 2026 statement from Nadella giving a date for AGI or superintelligence. I didn't see the claim already on file (100 million patient encounters, 2026-07-29), so it isn't repeated here.

1. **20VC podcast with Harry Stebbings (page dated 26 October 2026):** Nadella said that calling yourself an "AI native company" will be "pretty passe" five years from now. The page I read is a third-party transcript on 996.fm, not an official one.
2. **Same interview:** Asked what looks crazy today but will be common in five years, he answered "those evals". The five-year span is only in the question, not in his answer, so this one is weak.
3. **Morgan Stanley TMT Conference (4 March 2026):** He said that in the next year everybody will start relying on tool use to make AI use fewer tokens. This is the transcript excerpt Morgan Stanley published on its own site. The Investing.com transcript I opened was cut short and didn't contain these words.

**Left out:**
- His "Looking ahead to 2026" blog post, where 2026 is called "a pivotal year for AI", went up on 29 December 2025. It belongs to 2025.
- The Dwarkesh podcast ("maybe it takes five years, ten years, twenty years") looks like November 2025. I only saw it in a search snippet.
- Several 2026 items carry a date but aren't AI forecasts: India possibly leading the world in developers by 2030, and at Davos, tech's share of GDP and US market share "in five years". I didn't open those pages.
- His September and October 2026 posts on superintelligence needing human control and an "emergency brake" give no dates. I only saw them in news coverage.

**Not checked closely:**
- I didn't open the Davos transcripts. The 2026 earnings calls showed up in search results but I didn't open them, and the Stratechery interview I only saw in snippets.
- The 2026 Build keynote and the Latent Space / No Priors interview had nothing dated.

All 12 searches and all 6 page openings are used.
